question: Which of the following mountain ranges is considered as the boundary between Asia and Europe?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Urals__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Urals**

 
 
• The Urals or the Ural mountain forms a boundary between the continents of Europe and Asia.* *
 
• It runs from north to south of Western Russia, from the coast of the Arctic Ocean to the river of Ural and northwestern Kazakhstan.
 
• The length of the Urals is 2500 km and the elevation is 1895 m.
 
• Asia is the largest continent. It covers about one-third of the total land area of the earth.
 
• The continent lies in the Eastern Hemisphere.
 
• The Tropic of Cancer passes through this continent.
 
• Asia is separated from Europe by the Ural mountains on the west.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Alp**

 
• The Alps are the highest and most extensive mountain range system that are located in Europe.
 
• The mountain stretches approximately 1,200 kilometers across eight Alpine countries, namely: France, Switzerland, Italy, Monaco, Liechtenstein, Austria, Germany, and Slovenia.

**The Great Dividing Range**

 
• The Great Dividing Range is located in Australia.
 
• Its highest peak is Mount Kosciuszko, it is a Snowy Mountains which is 2800 meter high from the mainland of Australia.
 
• The mountain range stretches up to 3500 km from North to South.

**​Atlas**

 
• The Atlas Mountains, series of mountain ranges in northwestern Africa for more than 2,000 kilometres.
 
• The highest peak in the Atlas Mountain ranges is Mt.Toubkal (4165 meters).
